strings.en: Captain Bright...
Perhaps we should send operatives into Axis now and destroy it...
I see...
Captain Misumaru! Do you have personnel who can help?
Destroy Axis from the inside...?
...Judging by the internal structure data, I think it'd be effective...
Captain! I'll go! I've been itching to do something!
Good! All units! Cover the operatives until they reach Axis!
Colonel... A team from the Ra Cailum and the Nadesico is heading for Axis...
They probably intend to destroy it from within.
Londo Bell indeed... Very efficient.
...Colonel...
I suppose this is no time for praise...
Colonel! The enemy's infiltrating!
I know... Where are you right now?
I'm talking to the Colonel, okay!?
Quess, can you get to Deck 2?
Oh... Y-Yes. I can.
We have one more fight ahead. Get ready to sortie at once.
Got it, Colonel.
You're putting Quess... in that?
Yes. Let's proceed with our own preparations.
How's it going over there!?
Almost done! Quit rushing me.
Hey, Reika... Isn't this kind of creepy?
Oh, come on! Keep your hands moving.
What's bothering Beauty is the lack of enemy attacks, right?
It makes the job easier, but... I wonder if something's up.
Yes...
Commander Hazuki, Captain Misumaru, what's the enemy doing?
That's been on my mind as well...
No enemy contacts confirmed.
I bet Captain Quattro finally understood!
...No... A man who understood that wouldn't have done this to begin with.
...He's plotting something.
Right...
We'll land the decisive blow before they get organized.
Captain Bright! We're done!
Good! All hands, evacuate!
Whoa! It's starting to blow! Is Bright's team okay!?
We're fine. We just made it back to the ship.
The destruction is mostly going as planned...
Axis will begin breaking apart, as calculated.
Something's off! Why isn't the Captain's side coming out?
...No... I see units launching.
Looks like... they're not exactly escaping.
...Char, you...
